title: The bug fixer was moved into the groups, so it stops with them and spends their budget (2026-10-27)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: The bug fixer was supposed to be moved into all the groups. .. but then it's stops with the groups and uses the same issue budget

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-10-27; recorded verbatim. Context: Claude Code had reported that both working groups are paused on unreceived reports and that the SRS Bug Fixer cloud routine is disabled.
